issue_context.title: [Feature] Support for Async event hooks for Folio Reporter
issue_context.body:
Currently folio reporter expects event hooks like onEnd(), onTestEnd() to be synchronous, which creates a limitation when there is a requirement to make async calls in those functions, for instance making a network call when test ends. 

Similar test reporters like jest support event hooks to be async, below is the jest ReporterDispatcher [https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/5f4dd187d89070d07617444186684c20d9213031/packages/jest-core/src/ReporterDispatcher.ts](url)

Having a similar change would enable anyone to await async calls in events like onEnd() . This would essentially require the following changes:

- **multiplexer.ts** – Update event hooks like onEnd, onTestEnd to be async and awaiting the reporter event hook calls. 
- **runner.ts** – Update event hook calls to be awaited. this._reporter.onEnd(); => await this._reporter.onEnd();

Here is a[ sample PR ](https://github.com/microsoft/folio/pull/332) which has sample changes to make onEnd() async.
This is just a basic PR suggesting the changes and may not be in a good state to be merged.
